name: Zapier
verdict: The easiest way to automate without code, but the free plan is 100 tasks and paid tiers climb fast.
pros: Huge app catalog and a real free tier
Multi-step Zaps, webhooks, and AI start on Professional
cons: You pay for tasks, and AI steps can cost more than one
Team starts at 2,000 tasks, not the cheap Professional tiers
pricingNote: Self-serve prices scale with the task tier up to 2 million tasks a month. Annual is the lower figure and is billed yearly. Amounts above are the entry tier for each plan.
